claims.text: Smith was Chairman of the House Armed Services Committee in the 116th Congress, with Mac Thornberry as the senior Republican.
In the 116th Congress McCollum was Vice Chair of the House Appropriations Defense Subcommittee, not its chair or ranking minority member, and therefore did not hold a 119(e)(2) seat in 2020.
Calvert was the senior Republican on the House Appropriations Defense Subcommittee in the 116th Congress, when Peter J. Visclosky chaired it.

2020 holders (116th Congress), House: HASC Chairman Adam Smith, Ranking Member Mac Thornberry; HAC Chair Nita M. Lowey, Ranking Member Kay Granger; HAC Defense Subcommittee Chairman Peter J. Visclosky, Ranking Member Ken Calvert.
